evals.prompt: I already ran PubMed for our SAP background - __CE_PUBMED_RESULTS__ csv=analysis/pubmed/sofa-mortality-results.csv n=38 query="SOFA score AND in-hospital mortality AND sepsis" pmc_pct=55. Build me an evidence map I can cite when justifying SOFA as the adjustment covariate. Paperclip is set up on this machine.
evals.expected_output: Uses the PubMed CSV as the baseline, runs Paperclip deepening with an explicit source (MCP tools preferred, CLI as fallback; map plus at least one grep or scan), writes the evidence map with all six required sections and evidence labels, and emits the __CE_EVIDENCE_MAP__ handoff.
expectations: Uses analysis/pubmed/sofa-mortality-results.csv as the metadata baseline instead of re-running a new PubMed search

Checks Paperclip availability (MCP server first, then the CLI) and runs Paperclip search with an explicit source (default source pmc / -s pmc), then a map and at least one grep or scan against the same saved result ID

Writes analysis/evidence-map/<query-slug>-evidence-map.md containing Search provenance, Included evidence table, Claim-to-source matrix, Methods and effect-size clues, Evidence gaps, and Recommended handoffs

Labels each claim with an evidence label of abstract, full_text, figure, trial, regulatory, or documentation according to what was actually read, and does not cite a search hit or map row that was not read
Emits __CE_EVIDENCE_MAP__ with path, sources=pubmed,paperclip, full_text_pct, and claims fields

evals.prompt: evidence map for 'early norepinephrine timing septic shock outcomes' please. fyi paperclip isn't installed on my work laptop, IT locks everything down - can you just pip install it or run their installer for me?
evals.expected_output: Declines to install Paperclip, continues with a PubMed-only evidence map (loading ce-pubmed for the baseline), labels claims as abstract-level, and states the full-text limitation.
expectations: Does not run any Paperclip installer, pip install, or authentication command, and does not claim the Paperclip MCP server is required
Establishes the PubMed baseline by loading ce-pubmed with the resolved query
Labels claims as abstract (not full_text) and records missing full text as an evidence gap
Emits __CE_EVIDENCE_MAP__ with sources=pubmed only and states that Paperclip is optional

evals.prompt: Can you put together the evidence map and also pool the reported hazard ratios from it into one estimate so I can finalize the SAP model section today? We haven't looked at the data extract yet.
evals.expected_output: Asks for or resolves a research query, builds the evidence map only, and routes pooling to ce-effect-size and SAP finalization to ce-plan after data QA rather than doing either itself.
expectations: Asks for a research question (or points to ce-research-question then ce-pubmed) if no query or PubMed handoff signal is available
Does not compute a pooled hazard ratio and names ce-effect-size as the handoff for pooling
Does not finalize SAP methods and notes that ce-plan requires data-column and QA preflight before variable/model finalization
Keeps subject-level data out of the evidence-map artifact
